pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged dispatcher requests. This first applied stage adds the model-owned HumanoidProfile manifest contract and stable humanoid semantic IDs while preserving existing manifest schema compatibility rules. Subsequent requests add portable HumanoidMotion baking, import cataloging, Animation Set Auto/Native/Humanoid source selection, editor configuration, target resolution, and packaging.
